rows.note: This is the all-purpose and more formal choice for something that does not follow a standard pattern, including grammatical inflection.

example.english: The past tense of this verb has an irregular inflection.
example.traditional: 呢個動詞嘅過去式屬於不規則變化。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dung6 ci4 ge3 gwo3 heoi3 sik1 suk6 jyu1 bat1 kwai1 zak1 bin3 faa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial form in casual speech for a pattern, shape, or arrangement that is not regular or uniform.

example.english: The tiles on this wall are laid out in an irregular way.
example.traditional: 呢幅牆啲磚鋪得好唔規則。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 coeng4 di1 zyun1 pou1 dak1 hou2 m4 gwai1 zak1
